column3: MT 2:2. “On your face” is rendered “against you”; “guard the fortification” is rendered “Man the fortress,” and “loins” “back.”
MT 2:3. “Majesty” is rendered “splendor,” and “branches” “vine branches”; NASB adds “Even though.”
MT 2:4. “Fire of irons” is rendered “flashing steel,” and “the cypresses” “the cypress spears”; NASB supplies “to march.” The meaning is uncertain.
MT 2:6. NASB supplies “to her” before “wall,” and renders “the cover” as “the mantelet.”
MT 2:8. The Hebrew word rendered “it is fixed” is uncertain; NASB renders “hearts” as “breasts.”
MT 2:9. “From the days of it” is rendered “throughout her days”; NASB adds “Though” and “Now.”
MT 2:10. “Supply” is rendered “treasure,” and “article of preciousness” “desirable object.”
MT 2:11. NASB renders the three nouns as “She is emptied! … desolate and waste!”; “all loins” is rendered “the whole body,” and “gathered a glow” “grown pale.”
MT 2:14. “Chariotry its” is rendered “her chariots”; “earth” is rendered “land.”
